# sdjwt — Selective Disclosure JWTs

[All groups](README.md)

## sdjwt decode

Decode and check an SD-JWT or SD-JWT VC presentation (RFC 9901): every disclosure with its digest and where it lands, the reconstructed claims, undisclosed digests, the issuer signature (keys from jwt-vc-issuer or OAuth metadata, a JWKS, a PEM key, or x5c), and the key binding JWT (holder signature, sd_hash, nonce, audience, freshness).

MCP tool: `sdjwt_decode`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--token` | string | The SD-JWT: issuer JWT~disclosure~…~[KB-JWT] (CLI: @file or - for stdin). **Required.** CLI: `@path` reads a file, `-` reads stdin. |
| `--issuer` | string | Trusted issuer; keys come from its /.well-known/jwt-vc-issuer or OAuth metadata. |
| `--jwks-uri` | string | Issuer JWKS URL. |
| `--jwks` | string | Issuer JWKS, inline JSON or a path. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--pem` | string | Issuer public key or certificate (PEM). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--expected-aud` | string | Verifier identifier the KB-JWT aud must contain. |
| `--expected-nonce` | string | Nonce the KB-JWT must carry. |
| `--max-kb-age` | int | Oldest acceptable KB-JWT, in seconds. Default `300`. |
| `--leeway` | int | Clock skew allowance in seconds. Default `60`. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).
